name: Picone
instructions: The server lives in apps/server, the browser UI in apps/web, and shared wire types in packages/protocol.
packages/protocol is type-only — never add runtime values to it.
Pi owns conversation context; do not build a parallel context system around it.
docs/DESIGN.md describes what is built; docs/todo holds one file per known gap. When a gap is closed, move its design into DESIGN.md and delete the file — never leave it struck through.
